people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
translations.bsb: So he returned to Balak, who was standing there beside his burnt offering, with all the princes of Moab.
translations.kjv: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
translations.asv: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he was standing by his burnt-offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
